title: 第4章 死亡森林的异常

content_zh:
苏菲优雅的端起杯子，轻轻的喝了一口，忽然似乎想到了什么，正色了起来：“枫，你可知道最近“死亡森林”有什么异常？”
“异常？没啊”刘枫有些疑惑。
“我们分会前几天收到不少消息，大量高阶魔兽，离开了“死亡森林”的内部，向森林外面涌来，很多实力较弱的佣兵团都已经惨遭灭团了。”苏菲脸色凝重的道。
“哦，有这种事。”刘枫有点惊讶，心中一动，想起了那天救肯斯，不是就因为在森林外部出现了一只七阶魔兽“火云魔狮”吗。
“佣兵工会是如何处置这件事的？”刘枫问道。
“呵呵，佣兵总会已经下了A级任务“探察死亡森林魔兽暴乱之迷”，现在大陆上的很多有实力的佣兵团都已经在向“死亡森林”赶来了，A级任务都已经好几年没出现过了呢，那些佣兵团还不象狗见到骨头，色狼见到了**一般兴奋啊。”苏菲娇声笑道，最后还加上了俩句在佣兵工会听到的粗语。
刘枫摸了摸下巴，笑道：“那这下子，“冒险小镇”岂不是要风起云涌了。
“呵呵，枫，你可知道你也快有麻烦了。”苏菲娇笑得如同一只小狐狸。
“我？我能有什么麻烦，那些魔兽又不是我弄的。”刘枫不解的问道。
“呵呵，我听说这次四大佣兵团的带队之人正是他们的少团长，佣兵界称他们为“佣兵四杰”呢。”苏菲笑道，扳着雪白细长的玉指，一个一个的数着。
莫名其妙的看着玉人嘴角的那一丝迷人的笑容，刘枫心中忽的一动，探问道：“难道他们都是你的追求者？”
“槟果，恭喜你答对了，可惜没有奖。”苏菲拍着玉手娇笑道。
刘枫耸了耸肩头，满脸的无所谓，不过看着苏菲那因为自己这态度板起来的俏脸，只好恶狠狠的道：“谁如果想要打你的主意的话，那我就将他杀了。”
话语虽然狂妄，但是这是建立在实力的基础之上，强者，有这个资格。
*********
冒险小镇的一个月时间之中，果然如苏菲所说，无数的佣兵从大陆各个地方向小镇赶来。
风起云涌，强者云集。
冒险小镇中，人口突然爆满了起来，本地的旅馆都被撑的满满的，旅馆老板们整天乐得裂开的大嘴，合都合不拢，看着在大街上来来往往的佣兵，就象是他们亲爹来了一般。
一周过去了，因为死亡森林的极度危险，佣兵工会劝戒佣兵暂时不要进入，大多佣兵不情愿的答允了。
又是一周过去了，佣兵们终于不耐烦了。

一天后，第一个佣兵团迫不急待的冲进了死亡森林，随后，无数佣兵也跟着涌了进去。
小镇顿时清净了不少。
可是进入死亡森林的佣兵，就象是失踪了一般，竟无一人回来，小镇中喧闹的佣兵陷入了低沉。
一周后，一浑身鲜血的佣兵，从死亡森林跌跌撞撞的跑了出来，被路过的佣兵救了回去。
当日，震撼性的爆炸消息从醒转过来的佣兵口中传出。
“死亡森林中有一条黑色巨龙，黑龙身边有一布满血丝的巨蛋，巨龙实力。。。九阶。。。疑是刚生产之后，实力骤降。”
半日时间，消息经过各种渠道，迅速传遍整个夜阑大陆。
**************
消息传出，大陆为之震动。
巨龙，夜阑大陆生物链金字塔顶尖的存在，敢与和神灵相抗衡的强悍种族。
成年巨龙大多都在圣阶之上，至尊之下，巨龙一族的王甚至一出生就直达至尊阶。
然而，创世神的法则却也是公平的，有获得，就有付出。
巨龙获得了举世强悍的力量，但是却失去了正常的生殖能力，所以巨龙一族数量始终没有超过五百，巨龙一族最为颠峰的时候，数量也才三百之数，但是在经过众神时代后，数量剧减，虽至今修养了几百年，但也还不过百条。
因为巨龙强悍的力量，引起了人类的贪婪，妄想将之据为己有，达到自己邪恶的野心。
但是，身为金字塔塔尖存在的巨龙，怎么可能听命于在它们眼中似蝼蚁一般的人类，于是，无数心怀不轨的人，都消逝在巨龙那愤怒的龙息之中。
然而，人类的贪婪之心没有因此而结束，在看见捕获成年巨龙无望之下，他们把目光转向了那些实力稍弱的幼龙以及龙蛋。。。

content_en:
Sophie picked up the cup gracefully and took a sip. Suddenly she seemed to think of something and became serious: "Feng, do you know what's unusual in the "Forest of Death" recently?"
"Abnormal? No." Liu Feng was a little confused.
"Our branch has received a lot of news in the past few days. A large number of high-level monsters have left the interior of the "Death Forest" and poured out of the forest. Many weaker mercenary groups have been destroyed." Sophie said with a solemn face.
"Oh, there is such a thing." Liu Feng was a little surprised, and thought about the reason he saved Kensi that day because a seventh-level magical beast "Fire Cloud Demonic Lion" appeared outside the forest.
"How did the mercenary union handle this matter?" Liu Feng asked.
"Haha, the Mercenary Association has already issued an A-level mission "Exploring the Mystery of Warcraft Riots in the Forest of Death". Now many powerful mercenary groups on the mainland are rushing to the "Forest of Death". A-level missions have not appeared for several years. Those mercenary groups are not as excited as dogs when they see bones or perverts when they see a**." Sophie laughed softly, and finally added two swear words heard in the mercenary union.
Liu Feng touched his chin and said with a smile: "Then now, "Adventure Town" is going to be turbulent.
"Haha, Feng, do you know that you are about to be in trouble. "Sophie smiled like a little fox.
"Me? What trouble can I get into? I didn't cause those monsters. Liu Feng asked puzzledly.
"Haha, I heard that the leaders of the four major mercenary groups this time are their young commanders. The mercenary world calls them the "Four Elite Mercenaries". "Sophie smiled, counting them one by one with her slender snow-white jade fingers.
Looking at the charming smile on the corner of the beauty's mouth inexplicably, Liu Feng's heart suddenly moved and asked: "Are they all your suitors? "
"Binguo, congratulations on your correct answer, but it's a pity that there is no prize. "Sophie patted her beautiful hands and said with a sweet smile.
Liu Feng shrugged his shoulders, with an indifferent expression on his face, but looking at Sophie's pretty face that became serious because of his attitude, he could only say viciously: "If anyone wants to take advantage of you, I will kill him. "
Although the words are arrogant, they are based on strength. Strong people have this qualification.
*********
During the month in Adventure Town, as Sophie said, countless mercenaries came to the town from all over the mainland.
When the storm rises, the strong ones gather.
In the adventure town, the population suddenly overflowed, and the local hotels were filled to capacity. The hotel owners were so happy that they couldn't close their mouths all day long. Looking at the mercenaries coming and going on the street, it was like their biological fathers had arrived.
A week passed. Due to the extreme danger of the Death Forest, the mercenary union advised the mercenaries not to enter for the time being. Most of the mercenaries reluctantly agreed.
Another week passed, and the mercenaries finally became impatient.
One day later, the first mercenary group rushed into the Death Forest impatiently, and then countless mercenaries followed.
The town suddenly became a lot cleaner.
However, the mercenaries who entered the Death Forest seemed to have disappeared, and none of them came back. The noisy mercenaries in the town fell into a depression.
A week later, a mercenary covered in blood stumbled out of the Death Forest and was rescued by a passing mercenary.
That day, shocking news of the explosion came from the mouth of the mercenary who woke up.
"There is a giant black dragon in the forest of death. Next to the black dragon is a giant egg covered with bloodshot eyes. The dragon is powerful. . . Level nine. . . It is suspected that her strength dropped sharply just after giving birth. "
In half a day, the news quickly spread throughout Yelan Continent through various channels.
****************
When the news came out, the mainland was shocked.
The giant dragon, the existence at the top of the biological chain pyramid in Yelan Continent, dares to compete with the gods.A powerful race.
Most of the adult dragons are above the Saint level, below the Supreme level. The king of the dragon clan even reaches the Supreme level right after he is born.
However, the laws of the Creator God are also fair. If you get something, you will have to give something.
The giant dragons gained the most powerful power in the world, but lost their normal reproductive capacity. Therefore, the number of the giant dragon clan has never exceeded 500. At its peak, the number of the giant dragon clan was only 300. However, after the age of gods, the number has dropped sharply. Although they have been cultivated for hundreds of years, they still only have less than a hundred.
Because the powerful power of the dragon has aroused human greed, and they want to take it as their own to achieve their own evil ambitions.
However, how could a giant dragon that existed at the top of a pyramid take orders from humans who were like ants in their eyes? As a result, countless people with evil intentions disappeared in the dragon's angry breath.
However, human greed did not end because of this. Seeing that there was no hope of capturing adult dragons, they turned their attention to the weaker young dragons and dragon eggs. . .
